```{r Figure-1B}
per_chr_eqtl <- vector("list", 22)

for (i in 1:22) {

  fm_raw <- fread(f_fm)

    mutate(
      chr = paste0("chr", i),
      credible_set_id = paste(region, gene, cs, sep = "_")

  per_chr_eqtl[[i]] <- data.frame(
```

```{r figure-1D, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
# Figure 1D: Distance from fine-mapped QTL credible sets to target features


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Input files
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

summary_path <- paths_figure1$summary_path

gencode_bed_path <- paths_figure1$gencode_bed_path

peak_path <- paths_figure1$peak_path

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cs_size_quantile <- 0.75

distance_breaks <- c(0, 5e3, 10e3, 50e3, Inf)
distance_labels <- c("0–5 kb", "5–10 kb", "10–50 kb", "50 kb+")

# Reverse order controls the stacked-bar and legend order.
distance_levels <- rev(distance_labels)

caqtl_category_levels <- c(
  "no_Peak_overlap",
  "in_other_Peak",
  "in_caPeak"
)

plot_group_levels <- c(
  "eQTL",
  caqtl_category_levels
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Retain credible sets with sizes at or below the specified quantile.
filter_credible_sets_by_size <- function(
    data,
    credible_set_column,
    variant_column,
    quantile_cutoff = 0.75
) {
  required_columns <- c(
    credible_set_column,
    variant_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(data)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  credible_set_sizes <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[credible_set_column]]),
      !is.na(.data[[variant_column]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      .data[[credible_set_column]],
      .data[[variant_column]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data[[credible_set_column]]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_variants = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  maximum_size <- stats::quantile(
    credible_set_sizes$n_variants,
    probs = quantile_cutoff,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  retained_sets <- credible_set_sizes %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n_variants <= maximum_size
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(credible_set_column)
    )

  filtered_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      retained_sets,
      by = credible_set_column
    )

  list(
    data = filtered_data,
    credible_set_sizes = credible_set_sizes,
    maximum_size = maximum_size
  )
}


bin_distances <- function(distance) {
  cut(
    distance,
    breaks = distance_breaks,
    labels = distance_labels,
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    right = FALSE
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load fine-mapping and colocalization results
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

qtl_summary <- fread(summary_path, showProgress = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble()

eqtl_data <- qtl_summary %>%
  filter(coloc_status %in% c("coloc", "eQTL_only")) %>%
  filter_credible_sets_by_size(
    credible_set_column = "finemapped_cs_eqtl",
    variant_column = "variant_id.y",
    quantile_cutoff = cs_size_quantile
  )

caqtl_data <- qtl_summary %>%
  filter(coloc_status %in% c("coloc", "caQTL_only")) %>%
  filter_credible_sets_by_size(
    credible_set_column = "finemapped_cs_caqtl",
    variant_column = "variant_id.x",
    quantile_cutoff = cs_size_quantile
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate mean eQTL credible-set distance to the eGene TSS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gencode_bed <- fread(
  gencode_bed_path,
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE,
  showProgress = FALSE
)

bed_column_names <- c(
  "chr",
  "start_0based",
  "end",
  "gene",
  "score",
  "strand"
)

setnames(
  gencode_bed,
  old = names(gencode_bed)[seq_len(min(6, ncol(gencode_bed)))],
  new = bed_column_names[seq_len(min(6, ncol(gencode_bed)))]
)

if (!"strand" %in% names(gencode_bed)) {
  gencode_bed[, strand := "*"]
}

gene_tss <- gencode_bed %>%
  transmute(
    chr = as.character(chr),
    gene = as.character(gene),
    strand = as.character(strand),
    start = as.integer(start_0based) + 1L,
    end = as.integer(end),
    tss = if_else(strand == "+", start, end)
  ) %>%
  filter(str_detect(chr, "^chr(\\d+|X|Y)$")) %>%
  group_by(gene, chr) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = end - start,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

eqtl_counts <- eqtl_data$data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene,
    credible_set = finemapped_cs_eqtl,
    variant_chr = chr.y,
    variant_position = variant_pos.y
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(credible_set),
    !is.na(gene),
    !is.na(variant_chr),
    !is.na(variant_position)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    gene_tss %>%
      dplyr::select(
        gene,
        tss_chr = chr,
        tss
      ),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(variant_chr == tss_chr) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_to_tss = abs(variant_position - tss)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(credible_set) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_distance = mean(distance_to_tss),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = "eQTL",
    distance_bin = bin_distances(mean_distance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(distance_bin)) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    distance_bin,
    name = "n"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate mean caQTL credible-set distance to the caPeak center
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

peak_raw <- fread(
  peak_path,
  showProgress = FALSE
) %>%
  as_tibble()

peak_coordinates <- peak_raw %>%
  transmute(
    peak = as.character(.data[[names(peak_raw)[1]]]),
    peak_chr = as.character(Chr),
    peak_start = as.numeric(Start),
    peak_end = as.numeric(End)
  ) %>%
  filter(peak_chr %in% paste0("chr", 1:22)) %>%
  mutate(
    peak_center = peak_start + (peak_end - peak_start) / 2
  )

caqtl_counts <- caqtl_data$data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    credible_set = finemapped_cs_caqtl,
    peak,
    variant = variant_id.x,
    variant_chr = chr.x,
    variant_position = variant_pos.x,
    group = caqtl_category
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(credible_set),
    !is.na(peak),
    !is.na(variant),
    !is.na(variant_chr),
    !is.na(variant_position),
    !is.na(group)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    peak_coordinates,
    by = "peak"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    variant_chr == peak_chr
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_to_peak = abs(
      variant_position - peak_center
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    credible_set,
    group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_distance = mean(
      distance_to_peak,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    distance_bin = bin_distances(mean_distance)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(distance_bin)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    group,
    distance_bin,
    name = "n"
  )
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine results and plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_data <- bind_rows(eqtl_counts, caqtl_counts) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = plot_group_levels),
    distance_bin = factor(
      distance_bin,
      levels = distance_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  complete(
    group,
    distance_bin,
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  )

figure_1c <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = group,
    y = n,
    fill = distance_bin
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = "fill",
    width = 0.7,
    color = "grey20",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of credible sets",
    fill = "Mean distance",
    title = "Mean distance to eGene TSS or caPeak center",
    subtitle = "Credible sets at or below the 75th percentile of credible-set size"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

figure_1c
```

```{r figure-1E, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
# Figure 1E: Number of targets per locus

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

credible_set_quantile <- 0.75
jaccard_threshold <- 0.30

target_breaks <- c(1, 2, 11, Inf)
target_labels <- c("1", "2–10", "11+")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plotting functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_credible_set_sizes <- function(
    credible_set_sizes,
    x_max = 100,
    bin_width = 5,
    x_label = "Number of variants per credible set"
) {
  plot_data <- credible_set_sizes %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(n_variants),
      is.finite(n_variants)
    )

  size_summary <- summary(plot_data$n_variants)

  summary_label <- paste0(
    "N CS = ", comma(nrow(plot_data)), "\n",
    "Min = ", size_summary[["Min."]], "\n",
    "Q1 = ", size_summary[["1st Qu."]], "\n",
    "Median = ", size_summary[["Median"]], "\n",
    "Mean = ", round(mean(plot_data$n_variants), 2), "\n",
    "Q3 = ", size_summary[["3rd Qu."]], "\n",
    "Max = ", size_summary[["Max."]]
  )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = n_variants)) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = bin_width,
      boundary = 0,
      closed = "left"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = median(plot_data$n_variants),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = mean(plot_data$n_variants),
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "label",
      x = x_max * 0.65,
      y = Inf,
      label = summary_label,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1.1,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, x_max)) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = "Number of credible sets"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
}


plot_jaccard_distribution <- function(
    jaccard_data,
    bin_width = 0.02,
    title = "Jaccard overlap between credible-set intervals"
) {
  ggplot(jaccard_data, aes(x = jaccard)) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = bin_width,
      boundary = 0,
      closed = "left"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Jaccard index",
      y = "Number of credible-set pairs",
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_classic()
}


plot_target_distribution <- function(
    binned_data,
    title = "Targets per locus"
) {
  plot_data <- binned_data %>%
    group_by(qtl_type) %>%
    mutate(
      proportion = n / sum(n),
      percent_label = percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = qtl_type,
      y = n,
      fill = target_bin
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = "fill",
      width = 0.7,
      color = "grey20",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = if_else(
          proportion > 0.02,
          percent_label,
          ""
        )
      ),
      position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion of loci",
      fill = NULL,
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analyze one QTL type
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

analyze_qtl_loci <- function(
    data,
    qtl_type,
    credible_set_column,
    target_column,
    chromosome_column,
    position_column,
    size_quantile = 0.75,
    jaccard_threshold = 0.30,
    target_breaks = c(1, 2, 11, Inf),
    target_labels = c("1", "2–10", "11+"),
    histogram_x_max = 100,
    histogram_bin_width = 5
) {
  stopifnot(
    length(target_breaks) == length(target_labels) + 1,
    size_quantile > 0,
    size_quantile <= 1,
    jaccard_threshold >= 0,
    jaccard_threshold <= 1
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    credible_set_column,
    target_column,
    chromosome_column,
    position_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(data))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standardize input columns
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  qtl_data <- data %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      credible_set = as.character(.data[[credible_set_column]]),
      target = as.character(.data[[target_column]]),
      chromosome = as.character(.data[[chromosome_column]]),
      position = as.integer(.data[[position_column]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(credible_set),
      credible_set != "",
      !is.na(target),
      target != "",
      !is.na(chromosome),
      chromosome != "",
      !is.na(position)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  if (nrow(qtl_data) == 0) {
    stop("No valid QTL records remained after filtering missing values.")
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Credible-set size filtering
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  credible_set_sizes <- qtl_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      credible_set,
      chromosome,
      position
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(credible_set) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_variants = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  size_cutoff <- stats::quantile(
    credible_set_sizes$n_variants,
    probs = size_quantile,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    names = FALSE
  )

  retained_credible_sets <- credible_set_sizes %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_variants <= size_cutoff) %>%
    dplyr::select(credible_set)

  filtered_data <- qtl_data %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(
      retained_credible_sets,
      by = "credible_set"
    )

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert credible sets to genomic intervals
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  credible_set_intervals <- filtered_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      credible_set,
      chromosome
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      start = min(position),
      end = max(position),
      n_variants = dplyr::n_distinct(position),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (anyDuplicated(credible_set_intervals$credible_set) > 0) {
    stop(
      "At least one credible-set ID occurs on multiple chromosomes. ",
      "Credible-set IDs must be unique across chromosomes."
    )
  }

  credible_set_ranges <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
    seqnames = credible_set_intervals$chromosome,
    ranges = IRanges::IRanges(
      start = credible_set_intervals$start,
      end = credible_set_intervals$end
    ),
    credible_set = credible_set_intervals$credible_set
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Calculate pairwise credible-set interval overlap
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  overlap_hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(
    credible_set_ranges,
    credible_set_ranges,
    ignore.strand = TRUE
  )

  overlap_pairs <- as.data.frame(overlap_hits) %>%
    dplyr::filter(queryHits < subjectHits)

  if (nrow(overlap_pairs) == 0) {
    interval_overlap <- tibble::tibble(
      credible_set_1 = character(),
      credible_set_2 = character(),
      chromosome = character(),
      overlap_bp = integer(),
      union_bp = integer(),
      overlap_of_smaller = numeric(),
      jaccard = numeric()
    )
  } else {
    query_ranges <- credible_set_ranges[
      overlap_pairs$queryHits
    ]

    subject_ranges <- credible_set_ranges[
      overlap_pairs$subjectHits
    ]

    overlap_bp <- GenomicRanges::width(
      GenomicRanges::pintersect(
        query_ranges,
        subject_ranges,
        ignore.strand = TRUE
      )
    )

    query_width <- GenomicRanges::width(query_ranges)
    subject_width <- GenomicRanges::width(subject_ranges)

    union_bp <- query_width +
      subject_width -
      overlap_bp

    interval_overlap <- tibble::tibble(
      credible_set_1 = as.character(
        S4Vectors::mcols(query_ranges)$credible_set
      ),
      credible_set_2 = as.character(
        S4Vectors::mcols(subject_ranges)$credible_set
      ),
      chromosome = as.character(
        GenomicRanges::seqnames(query_ranges)
      ),
      overlap_bp = overlap_bp,
      union_bp = union_bp,
      overlap_of_smaller = overlap_bp /
        pmin(query_width, subject_width),
      jaccard = overlap_bp / union_bp
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cluster credible sets into loci using connected components
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  locus_edges <- interval_overlap %>%
    dplyr::filter(jaccard >= jaccard_threshold) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      from = credible_set_1,
      to = credible_set_2
    )

  locus_vertices <- tibble::tibble(
    name = credible_set_intervals$credible_set
  )

  locus_graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    d = locus_edges,
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = locus_vertices
  )

  locus_membership <- igraph::components(
    locus_graph
  )$membership

  locus_map <- tibble::tibble(
    credible_set = names(locus_membership),
    locus_id = as.integer(locus_membership)
  )

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Count unique targets per locus
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  targets_per_locus <- filtered_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      credible_set,
      target
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      locus_map,
      by = "credible_set"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(locus_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_targets = dplyr::n_distinct(target),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bin the number of targets per locus
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  binned_targets <- targets_per_locus %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      target_bin = cut(
        n_targets,
        breaks = target_breaks,
        labels = target_labels,
        right = FALSE,
        include.lowest = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(target_bin)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(target_bin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(
      target_bin = factor(
        target_labels,
        levels = target_labels
      ),
      fill = list(n = 0L)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      qtl_type = qtl_type,
      target_bin = factor(
        as.character(target_bin),
        levels = rev(target_labels)
      ),
      proportion = n / sum(n)
    )

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return results
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  list(
    qtl_type = qtl_type,
    size_cutoff = size_cutoff,
    credible_set_sizes = credible_set_sizes,
    filtered_data = filtered_data,
    credible_set_intervals = credible_set_intervals,
    interval_overlap = interval_overlap,
    locus_map = locus_map,
    targets_per_locus = targets_per_locus,
    binned_targets = binned_targets,

    credible_set_size_plot = plot_credible_set_sizes(
      credible_set_sizes,
      x_max = histogram_x_max,
      bin_width = histogram_bin_width,
      x_label = paste0(
        qtl_type,
        ": variants per credible set"
      )
    ),

    jaccard_plot = plot_jaccard_distribution(
      interval_overlap,
      title = paste0(
        qtl_type,
        ": credible-set interval overlap; threshold = ",
        jaccard_threshold
      )
    )
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compare eQTL and caQTL distributions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

compare_qtl_distributions <- function(
    eqtl_results,
    caqtl_results,
    target_labels
) {
  combined_data <- bind_rows(
    eqtl_results$binned_targets,
    caqtl_results$binned_targets
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      target_bin = factor(
        as.character(target_bin),
        levels = rev(target_labels)
      ),
      qtl_type = factor(
        qtl_type,
        levels = c("eQTL", "caQTL")
      )
    )

  contingency_table <- combined_data %>%
    dplyr::select(
      qtl_type,
      target_bin,
      n
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = target_bin,
      values_from = n,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    arrange(qtl_type)

  contingency_matrix <- as.matrix(
    contingency_table[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  )

  rownames(contingency_matrix) <-
    contingency_table$qtl_type

  chi_square_test <- suppressWarnings(
    chisq.test(contingency_matrix)
  )

  if (all(chi_square_test$expected >= 5)) {
    global_test <- chi_square_test

    diagnostics <- list(
      expected = chi_square_test$expected,
      standardized_residuals = chi_square_test$stdres,
      contributions = (
        chi_square_test$observed -
          chi_square_test$expected
      )^2 / chi_square_test$expected
    )
  } else {
    global_test <- fisher.test(
      contingency_matrix
    )

    diagnostics <- NULL
  }

  list(
    binned_data = combined_data,
    contingency_table = contingency_matrix,
    global_test = global_test,
    diagnostics = diagnostics,
    plot = plot_target_distribution(
      combined_data,
      title = "Number of targets per QTL locus"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r Figure-F, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
# 1) Plot helpers (your style)

BAR_WIDTH <- 0.6

stack_prop2 <- function(df, x_var, fill_var, title, legend_title, label_min = 0.03) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = prop, fill = {{ fill_var }})) +
    geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2) +  # <-- default stack
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(prop >= label_min, scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3,
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, fill = legend_title) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") +
    coord_flip()
}
stack_prop_any <- function(df, x_var = NULL, fill_var,
                           title = "", legend_title = "",
                           label_min = 0.03,
                           x_const = "All CS") {
  
  # If no x_var supplied, create a constant x so everything stacks into one bar
  if (is.null(x_var)) {
    df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(.x = x_const)
    x_var <- rlang::sym(".x")
  } else {
    x_var <- rlang::enquo(x_var)
  }
  
  fill_var <- rlang::enquo(fill_var)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = !!x_var, y = prop, fill = !!fill_var)) +
    geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(prop >= label_min, scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3,
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, fill = legend_title) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")
}

# Dodged barplot with percent labels + per-state q label above each state
plot_dodged_states_with_q <- function(plot_df,
                                      group_col, state_col, prop_col,
                                      q_tbl,
                                      title = "", subtitle = "",
                                      y_pad = 0.06) {
  
  # plot_df columns: group_col, state_col, prop_col
  # q_tbl columns: cs_state, q_label (and maybe others)
  ann <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(.data[[state_col]]) %>%
    summarise(max_prop = max(.data[[prop_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    transmute(cs_state = .data[[state_col]], max_prop) %>%
    left_join(q_tbl %>% transmute(cs_state, q_label), by = "cs_state") %>%
    mutate(y = pmin(max_prop + y_pad, 0.98))
  
  ymax <- min(1, max(ann$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05)
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[state_col]], y = .data[[prop_col]], fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.75,
             color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = scales::percent(.data[[prop_col]], accuracy = 0.1)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
      vjust = -0.25, size = 3
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = ann,
      aes(x = cs_state, y = y, label = q_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      limits = c(0, ymax),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Chromatin state (collapsed)", y = "Proportion (within group)", fill = NULL,
         title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
}

# -----------------------------
# 2) Core helpers: filtering + GRanges + annotation + majority vote
# -----------------------------
filter_bottom_cs <- function(df, cs_col, var_col, q = 0.75) {
  cs_sym  <- rlang::sym(cs_col)
  var_sym <- rlang::sym(var_col)
  
  cs_sizes <- df %>%
    distinct(!!cs_sym, !!var_sym) %>%
    dplyr::count(!!cs_sym, name = "n_variants_per_cs")
  
  q_cut <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(cs_sizes$n_variants_per_cs, q, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  keep_cs <- cs_sizes %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_variants_per_cs <= q_cut) %>%
    dplyr::select(!!cs_sym)
  
  df_filt <- df %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(keep_cs, by = cs_col)
  
  list(df = df_filt, cs_sizes = cs_sizes, q_cut = q_cut)
}


make_variants_gr <- function(df, var_id_col, chr_col, pos_col) {
  u <- df %>%
    distinct(
      variant_id = .data[[var_id_col]],
      chr        = .data[[chr_col]],
      pos        = .data[[pos_col]]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(variant_id), !is.na(chr), !is.na(pos))
  
  gr <- GRanges(seqnames = u$chr,
                ranges   = IRanges(start = u$pos, end = u$pos))
  mcols(gr)$variant_id <- u$variant_id
  gr
}

collapse_chrom_state <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c("TssA", "TssFlnkU", "TssFlnkD", "TssFlnk", "TssBiv") ~ "Promoter",
    x %in% c("EnhA1", "EnhA2", "EnhG1", "EnhG2", "EnhBiv")       ~ "Enhancer_active",
    x %in% c("EnhWk")                                            ~ "Enhancer_weak",
    x %in% c("Tx", "TxWk")                                       ~ "Transcribed",
    x %in% c("ReprPC", "ReprPCWk")                               ~ "Repressed_polycomb",
    x %in% c("ZNF/Rpts", "Het", "Quies")                         ~ "ZNF_Het_Quies",
    TRUE                                                         ~ NA_character_
  )
}

annotate_variants_with_chromstate <- function(variantsGR, chrom_bed_path) {
  states <- rtracklayer::import.bed(chrom_bed_path)
  ov <- findOverlaps(variantsGR, states, ignore.strand = TRUE)
  
  variantsGR$T_cell_chromatin_state <- NA_character_
  variantsGR$T_cell_chromatin_state[queryHits(ov)] <- states$name[subjectHits(ov)]
  
  tibble(
    variant_id = mcols(variantsGR)$variant_id,
    T_cell_chromatin_state = variantsGR$T_cell_chromatin_state,
    chrom_state_group = collapse_chrom_state(variantsGR$T_cell_chromatin_state)
  )
}

# majority vote per CS (optionally stratified by some grouping columns like caqtl_category)
majority_vote_cs <- function(df, cs_col, label_col, by_cols = NULL, levels_ordered = NULL) {
  
  cs_sym  <- rlang::sym(cs_col)
  lab_sym <- rlang::sym(label_col)
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .cs  = !!cs_sym,
      .lab = !!lab_sym
    )
  
  # enforce factor order so ties break by your priority
  if (!is.null(levels_ordered)) {
    tmp <- tmp %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.lab = factor(.lab, levels = levels_ordered, ordered = TRUE))
  }
  
  if (is.null(by_cols)) {
    
    out <- tmp %>%
      #dplyr::filter(!is.na(.lab)) %>%
      dplyr::count(.cs, .lab, name = "N") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(.cs, dplyr::desc(N), .lab) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.cs) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        !!cs_sym := .cs,
        cs_label = as.character(.lab)
      )
    
  } else {
    
    by_syms <- rlang::syms(by_cols)
    
    out <- tmp %>%
      #dplyr::filter(!is.na(.lab)) %>%
      dplyr::count(!!!by_syms, .cs, .lab, name = "N") %>%
      dplyr::arrange(!!!by_syms, .cs, dplyr::desc(N), .lab) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!!by_syms, .cs) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        !!!by_syms,
        !!cs_sym := .cs,
        cs_label = as.character(.lab)
      )
  }
  
  out
}


# -----------------------------
# 3) Chi-square helpers for chromatin state distributions
# -----------------------------
chisq_global <- function(count_df, group_col, state_col, count_col) {
  tab <- count_df %>%
    transmute(
      g = as.character(.data[[group_col]]),
      s = as.character(.data[[state_col]]),
      n = .data[[count_col]]
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = s, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    arrange(g)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(tab[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- tab$g
  suppressWarnings(chisq.test(mat))
}

# per-state 2x2 (state vs rest), BH across states
per_state_2x2 <- function(count_df, group_col, state_col, count_col) {
  tab <- count_df %>%
    transmute(
      g = as.character(.data[[group_col]]),
      s = as.character(.data[[state_col]]),
      n = .data[[count_col]]
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = s, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    arrange(g)
  
  mat <- as.matrix(tab[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- tab$g
  states_here <- colnames(mat)
  
  out <- map_dfr(states_here, function(st) {
    in_st <- mat[, st]
    other <- rowSums(mat) - in_st
    m2 <- cbind(in_state = in_st, other = other)
    tt <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(m2))
    
    tibble(
      cs_state = st,
      p_value  = tt$p.value,
      method   = tt$method
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      q_label  = paste0("q = ", format.pval(p_adj_BH, digits = 2, eps = 1e-300))
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_value)
  
  out
}

# Pairwise comparisons within caQTL categories: per-state q-values within each pair
pairwise_per_state <- function(count_df, group_col, state_col, count_col) {
  cats <- levels(factor(count_df[[group_col]]))
  pairs <- combn(cats, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  map_dfr(pairs, function(p) {
    g1 <- p[1]; g2 <- p[2]
    sub <- count_df %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c(g1, g2))
    
    per <- per_state_2x2(sub, group_col = group_col, state_col = state_col, count_col = count_col) %>%
      mutate(g1 = g1, g2 = g2, pair = paste0(g1, " vs ", g2))
    
    per
  })
}

# ============================================================
# A) eQTL pipeline (filter -> GR -> genomic region  -> chrom states)
# ============================================================

eqtl_f <- filter_bottom_cs(eqtl_df0,
                           cs_col  = "finemapped_cs_eqtl",
                           var_col = "variant_id.y",
                           q = q_keep)
eqtl_df_filt <- eqtl_f$df
message("eQTL CS-size cutoff (", q_keep*100, "%): <= ", eqtl_f$q_cut, " variants per CS")

eqtl.variantsGR <- make_variants_gr(eqtl_df_filt,
                                    var_id_col = "variant_id.y",
                                    chr_col    = "chr.y",
                                    pos_col    = "variant_pos.y")

# ----  eQTL genomic region via locateVariants + CS majority vote
txdb <- GenomicFeatures::makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf_path)

hits_list <- list(
  coding     = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, CodingVariants()),
  fiveUTR    = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, FiveUTRVariants()),
  threeUTR   = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, ThreeUTRVariants()),
  spliceSite = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, SpliceSiteVariants()),
  intron     = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, IntronVariants()),
  promoter   = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, PromoterVariants(upstream = 2000, downstream = 200)),
  intergenic = locateVariants(eqtl.variantsGR, txdb, IntergenicVariants())
)
rm(txdb)
hits_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(hits_list), function(lbl) {
  hmc <- as.data.frame(S4Vectors::mcols(hits_list[[lbl]]))
  stopifnot("QUERYID" %in% names(hmc))
  data.frame(QUERYID = as.integer(hmc$QUERYID), region = lbl, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}), use.names = TRUE)
rm(hits_list)
hits_one <- hits_tbl %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = region_priority, ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(QUERYID) %>%
  slice_min(as.integer(region), with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(variant_id = mcols(eqtl.variantsGR)$variant_id[QUERYID]) %>%
  dplyr::select(variant_id, region)

region_map <- tibble(variant_id = mcols(eqtl.variantsGR)$variant_id) %>%
  left_join(hits_one, by = "variant_id") %>%
  mutate(
    region = forcats::fct_explicit_na(region, na_level = "intergenic"),
    region = forcats::fct_expand(region, region_priority),
    region = forcats::fct_relevel(region, region_priority),
    region = as.character(region)
  )

eqtl_region_df <- eqtl_df_filt %>%
  dplyr::select(finemapped_cs_eqtl, variant_id = variant_id.y) %>%
  left_join(region_map, by = "variant_id") %>%
  distinct(finemapped_cs_eqtl, variant_id, region)
#rm(hits_one)
#rm(region_map)
cs_region_major <- majority_vote_cs(
  eqtl_region_df,
  cs_col = "finemapped_cs_eqtl",
  label_col = "region",
  by_cols = NULL,
  levels_ordered = region_priority
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cs_region = cs_label)

eqtl_region_counts <- cs_region_major %>%
  mutate(cs_region = if_else(cs_region %in% c("fiveUTR","threeUTR"), "UTR", cs_region)) %>%
  dplyr::count(cs_region, name = "n_cs") %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cs / sum(n_cs),
         cs_region = fct_reorder(cs_region, n_cs, .desc = TRUE))
#rm(cs_region_major)
eqtl_annot_region_pt <- stack_prop_any(
  eqtl_region_counts,
  x_var = NULL,
  fill_var = cs_region,
  title = "eQTL CS genomic annotation (majority; bottom 75% CS sizes)",
  legend_title = "Genomic region",
  x_const = "All CS"
) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE)

# ---- eQTL chromatin state overlap (variant -> CS majority)
eqtl_var_state_tbl <- annotate_variants_with_chromstate(eqtl.variantsGR, chrom_bed_path)

eqtl_state_df <- eqtl_df_filt %>%
  dplyr::select(finemapped_cs_eqtl, variant_id = variant_id.y) %>%
  left_join(eqtl_var_state_tbl %>% dplyr::select(variant_id, chrom_state_group),
            by = "variant_id") %>%
  distinct(finemapped_cs_eqtl, variant_id, chrom_state_group) %>%
  mutate(chrom_state_group = factor(chrom_state_group, levels = cs_state_levels, ordered = TRUE))


eqtl_state_major <- majority_vote_cs(
  eqtl_state_df,
  cs_col = "finemapped_cs_eqtl",
  label_col = "chrom_state_group",
  by_cols = NULL,
  levels_ordered = cs_state_levels
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cs_state = cs_label)


eqtl_state_counts <- eqtl_state_major %>%
  dplyr::count(cs_state, name = "n_cs") %>%
  complete(cs_state = factor(cs_state_levels, levels = cs_state_levels),
           fill = list(n_cs = 0L)) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cs / sum(n_cs),
         cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = rev(cs_state_levels)))

eqtl_chrom_state_pt <- stack_prop_any(
  eqtl_state_counts,
  x_var = NULL,
  fill_var = cs_state,
  title = "eQTL CS chromatin state (majority; bottom 75% CS sizes)",
  legend_title = "Chromatin state",
  x_const = "All CS"
) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE)


# ============================================================
# B) caQTL pipeline (standardized to match eQTL)
# ============================================================

caqtl_df0 <- caqtl_df0 %>%
  mutate(
    caqtl_category = ifelse(cs_type_any_var %in% c("in_corr_Peak", "in_other_Peak"),
                            "in_other_Peak",
                            cs_type_any_var),
    caqtl_category = factor(caqtl_category, levels = caqtl_cat_levels)
  )

caqtl_f <- filter_bottom_cs(caqtl_df0,
                            cs_col  = "finemapped_cs_caqtl",
                            var_col = "variant_id.x",
                            q = q_keep)
caqtl_df_filt <- caqtl_f$df
message("caQTL CS-size cutoff (", q_keep*100, "%): <= ", caqtl_f$q_cut, " variants per CS")

caqtl.variantsGR <- make_variants_gr(caqtl_df_filt,
                                     var_id_col = "variant_id.x",
                                     chr_col    = "chr.x",
                                     pos_col    = "variant_pos.x")

caqtl_var_state_tbl <- annotate_variants_with_chromstate(caqtl.variantsGR, chrom_bed_path)

caqtl_state_df <- caqtl_df_filt %>%
  dplyr::select(finemapped_cs_caqtl, caqtl_category, variant_id = variant_id.x) %>%
  left_join(caqtl_var_state_tbl %>% dplyr::select(variant_id, chrom_state_group),
            by = "variant_id") %>%
  distinct(finemapped_cs_caqtl, caqtl_category, variant_id, chrom_state_group) %>%
  mutate(chrom_state_group = factor(chrom_state_group, levels = cs_state_levels, ordered = TRUE))

caqtl_state_major <- majority_vote_cs(caqtl_state_df,
                                      cs_col = "finemapped_cs_caqtl",
                                      label_col = "chrom_state_group",
                                      by_cols = c("caqtl_category"),
                                      levels_ordered = cs_state_levels) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cs_state = cs_label)

# counts per category x state (CS-level majority)
caqtl_state_counts <- caqtl_state_major %>%
  dplyr::count(caqtl_category, cs_state, name = "n_cs") %>%
  complete(
    caqtl_category = factor(caqtl_cat_levels, levels = caqtl_cat_levels),
    cs_state       = factor(cs_state_levels, levels = cs_state_levels),
    fill = list(n_cs = 0L)
  ) %>%
  group_by(caqtl_category) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cs / sum(n_cs),
         cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = rev(cs_state_levels))) %>%
  ungroup()

caqtl_chrom_state_pt <- stack_prop2(
  caqtl_state_counts,
  x_var = caqtl_category,
  fill_var = cs_state,
  title = "caQTL CS chromatin state by category (majority; bottom 75% CS sizes)",
  legend_title = "Chromatin state"
) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE)


caqtl_state_counts_all <- caqtl_state_major %>%
  dplyr::count(cs_state, name = "n_cs") %>%
  complete(cs_state = factor(cs_state_levels, levels = cs_state_levels),
           fill = list(n_cs = 0L)) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cs / sum(n_cs),
         cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = rev(cs_state_levels)))

caqtl_chrom_state_all_pt <-stack_prop_any(

  title = "caQTL CS chromatin state (majority; bottom 75% CS sizes)",
  legend_title = "Chromatin state",
  x_const = "All CS"
) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE)


# ============================================================
# C) Stats + plot: eQTL vs caQTL_all (chromatin states)
# ============================================================

eqtl_cs_state_tbl <- eqtl_state_major %>%
  transmute(group = factor("eQTL", levels = c("eQTL","caQTL_all")),
            cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = cs_state_levels))

caqtl_all_cs_state_tbl <- caqtl_state_major %>%
  transmute(group = factor("caQTL_all", levels = c("eQTL","caQTL_all")),
            cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = cs_state_levels))

eqtl_vs_caqtl_state_counts <- bind_rows(eqtl_cs_state_tbl, caqtl_all_cs_state_tbl) %>%
  dplyr::count(group, cs_state, name = "n_cs") %>%
  complete(group = factor(c("eQTL","caQTL_all"), levels = c("eQTL","caQTL_all")),
           cs_state = factor(cs_state_levels, levels = cs_state_levels),
           fill = list(n_cs = 0L)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(prop = n_cs / sum(n_cs)) %>%
  ungroup()

chi_eqtl_vs_caqtl_global <- chisq_global(eqtl_vs_caqtl_state_counts,
                                         group_col = "group",
                                         state_col = "cs_state",
                                         count_col = "n_cs")

chi_eqtl_vs_caqtl_perstate <- per_state_2x2(eqtl_vs_caqtl_state_counts,
                                            group_col = "group",
                                            state_col = "cs_state",
                                            count_col = "n_cs") %>%
  mutate(cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = cs_state_levels))

plot_eqtl_vs_caqtl_states <- plot_dodged_states_with_q(
  plot_df = eqtl_vs_caqtl_state_counts %>%
    mutate(cs_state = factor(cs_state, levels = cs_state_levels)),
  group_col = "group",
  state_col = "cs_state",
  prop_col  = "prop",
  q_tbl     = chi_eqtl_vs_caqtl_perstate,
  title     = "Chromatin state distribution: eQTL vs caQTL (collapsed)",
  subtitle  = "State labels show BH-adjusted q-values from per-state (state vs rest) 2x2 chi-square."
)


# ============================================================
# E) forest plot
# ============================================================
df <- caqtl_state_major %>%
  distinct(caqtl_category, finemapped_cs_caqtl, cs_state)  # one row per CS

N <- nrow(df)

cat_tot <- df %>% dplyr::count(caqtl_category, name = "n_cat")
state_tot <- df %>% dplyr::count(cs_state, name = "n_state")

grid <- df %>%
  dplyr::count(caqtl_category, cs_state, name = "a") %>%          # a = in C AND in S
  left_join(cat_tot, by = "caqtl_category") %>%
  left_join(state_tot, by = "cs_state") %>%
  mutate(
    b = n_cat - a,                                         # in C AND not S
    c = n_state - a,                                       # not C AND in S
    d = N - a - b - c                                      # not C AND not S
  )

fisher_one <- function(a,b,c,d){
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a,b,c,d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
  tibble(
    odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
    conf_low   = unname(ft$conf.int[1]),
    conf_high  = unname(ft$conf.int[2]),
    p_value    = ft$p.value
  )
}

res <- grid %>%
  mutate(out = pmap(list(a,b,c,d), fisher_one)) %>%
  unnest(out) %>%
  group_by(caqtl_category) %>%                             # BH within category
  mutate(q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(caqtl_category, q_value)

res


# helper: q-value -> asterisks
q_to_stars <- function(q) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(q) ~ "",
    q < 1e-3 ~ "***",
    q < 1e-2 ~ "**",
    q < 5e-2 ~ "*",
    TRUE     ~ ""
  )
}

plot_df <- res %>%
  mutate(
    sig   = q_value < 0.05,
    stars = q_to_stars(q_value),
    cs_state = fct_reorder(cs_state, odds_ratio, .fun = median, .na_rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% mutate(
    caqtl_category = factor(
      caqtl_category,
      levels = c("in_caPeak","in_other_Peak","no_Peak_overlap")   # <- your desired top→bottom order
    )
  )


# put stars just to the right of the CI, but not past the axis max
star_pos <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(caqtl_category) %>%
  summarise(
    x_star = pmin(6.0, max(conf_high, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_df <- plot_df %>% left_join(star_pos, by = "caqtl_category")

p_forest <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = cs_state, x = odds_ratio)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf_low, xmax = conf_high),
                 height = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(size = -log10(q_value), alpha = sig), shape = 16) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_star, label = stars),
            vjust = 0.35, size = 4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10(
    limits = c(0.1, 6.0),
    breaks = c(0.1,0.2,0.4,0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.6, 4.8), name = expression(-log[10](q))) +
  facet_wrap(~ caqtl_category, ncol = 1) +   # <- same x across facets
  labs(
    x = "Odds ratio (log10 scale)", y = NULL,
    title = "Chromatin-state enrichment by caQTL category",
    subtitle = "Points show OR; bars show 95% CI. Asterisks denote BH q-value (*<0.05, **<0.01, ***<0.001)."
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.9, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5)  # extra right margin for stars
  )

p_forest
```

```{r Figure-G, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
#coloc percent

# -----------------------------
# Global style
# -----------------------------
BAR_WIDTH <- 0.6
BASE_SIZE <- 12

# -----------------------------
# Plot helpers
# -----------------------------
stack_prop_onebar <- function(df, fill_var, title, legend_title, label_min = 0.03) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = "All CS", y = n, fill = {{ fill_var }})) +
    geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2, position = "fill") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(n / sum(n) >= label_min, percent(n / sum(n), accuracy = 0.1), "")),
      position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3, color = "grey20"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, fill = legend_title) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") +
    coord_flip()
}

stack_prop_by_group <- function(df, x_var, fill_var, title, legend_title, label_min = 0.03) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = {{ x_var }}, y = prop, fill = {{ fill_var }})) +
    geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2, position = "fill") +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(prop >= label_min, percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
      position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 3, color = "grey20"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, fill = legend_title) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "right") +
    coord_flip()
}

# -----------------------------
# Stats helper: ONE comparison (global 2xK) for coloc vs not-coloc across categories
# -----------------------------
coloc_only_global <- function(plot_df,
                              cat_col = "caqtl_category",
                              status_col = "coloc_status",
                              n_col = "n",
                              coloc_level = "coloc") {
  
  coloc_counts <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(is_coloc = (.data[[status_col]] == coloc_level)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[cat_col]], is_coloc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(.data[[n_col]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::complete(!!rlang::sym(cat_col), is_coloc, fill = list(n = 0L)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = is_coloc, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::rename(n_not_coloc = `FALSE`, n_coloc = `TRUE`) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = n_coloc + n_not_coloc,
      prop_coloc = dplyr::if_else(total > 0, n_coloc / total, NA_real_)
    )
  
  # 2 x K contingency: rows = categories, cols = (coloc, not_coloc)
  mat <- as.matrix(coloc_counts[, c("n_coloc", "n_not_coloc"), drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- as.character(coloc_counts[[cat_col]])
  storage.mode(mat) <- "integer"
  
  # One global test: chi-square if expected ok, else Fisher
  chisq0 <- suppressWarnings(stats::chisq.test(mat, correct = FALSE))
  exp_ok <- all(chisq0$expected >= 5)
  
  global <- if (exp_ok) chisq0 else stats::fisher.test(mat)
  
  list(
    coloc_counts = coloc_counts,
    contingency  = mat,
    global_test  = global
  )
}

    caqtl_category = factor(
      caqtl_category,
      levels = desired_cats
    ),
    coloc_status = factor(
      coloc_status,
      levels = status_levels
    ),
    n = n
  )

# Global comparison
out <- coloc_only_global(plot_df_pairwise)

coloc_counts_tbl <- out$coloc_counts %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    caqtl_category = factor(
      caqtl_category,
      levels = desired_cats
    ),
    pct_label = scales::percent(
      prop_coloc,
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(caqtl_category)

global_coloc_test <- out$global_test

x2 <- unname(global_coloc_test$statistic)
test_df <- unname(global_coloc_test$parameter)

p_exact <- stats::pchisq(
  x2,
  df = test_df,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

sprintf(
  "Pearson’s χ²(%d) = %.2f, p = %.2e",
  test_df,
  x2,
  p_exact
)


caqtl_coloc_stack_pt
```
